bodyHtml:
Find out which medication is right for you!

Although we are experts in surgical weight loss at JourneyLite, we have 15 years of experience treatment patients with powerful weight loss medications as well.  Affordable options such as Adipex and phentermine are available, as well as newer state-of-the-art art injectable GLP-1 receptor agonists such as Wegovy and semaglutide.  At an affordable cost of only $199, you will meet with a physician or nurse practitioner and a registered dietitian.  Our team will help you find a medication to help you succeed that is within your budget!

After your initial consultation, monthly visits with a medical provider and a registered dietitian will continue through the duration of the program.  Depending on the regulations of your particular state, some of these visits may be virtual!

Call or request an appointment today, and start getting your health and quality of life back on track!

Request an appointment now!
